title: Europe Links AI Competitiveness with Public Trust in Dublin

sources.name: European Council
sources.title: Informal meeting of heads of state or government, 13 November 2026

sources.name: European Council
sources.title: Remarks by President António Costa at the press conference following the informal meeting of Heads of State or Government of 13 November 2026

sources.name: Irish Presidency of the Council of the European Union
sources.title: Taoiseach Micheál Martin hosts informal meeting of the European Council

paragraphs.en: European Union leaders met in Dublin
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟領袖在都柏林會面，

paragraphs.en: on November 13, 2026,
paragraphs.zh: 日期是2026年11月13日，

paragraphs.en: for an informal European Council meeting.
paragraphs.zh: 這是一場非正式歐洲理事會會議。

paragraphs.en: Their first dedicated strategic discussion on artificial intelligence
paragraphs.zh: 他們首次針對人工智慧進行專門的策略討論，

paragraphs.en: connected two concerns: economic competitiveness and public trust.
paragraphs.zh: 將兩項關切連結起來：經濟競爭力與公眾信任。

paragraphs.en: The official meeting report described both
paragraphs.zh: 官方會議報告同時說明了

paragraphs.en: opportunities for European industry
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲產業面臨的機會，

paragraphs.en: and wider effects on society and security.
paragraphs.zh: 以及這項科技對社會與安全的更廣泛影響。

paragraphs.en: One guest was Arthur Mensch,
paragraphs.zh: 受邀來賓之一是亞瑟．孟許，

paragraphs.en: chief executive of Mistral AI.
paragraphs.zh: 他是Mistral AI公司的執行長。

paragraphs.en: The discussion with him addressed
paragraphs.zh: 與他的討論聚焦於

paragraphs.en: Europe's position in the global AI industry.
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲在全球人工智慧產業中的地位。

paragraphs.en: Leaders considered public and private investment,
paragraphs.zh: 領袖們考量了公私部門投資、

paragraphs.en: stronger European capabilities, and reliable supply chains.
paragraphs.zh: 更強的歐洲能力，以及可靠的供應鏈。

paragraphs.en: They also examined access to clean, affordable energy,
paragraphs.zh: 他們也檢視如何取得潔淨且價格可負擔的能源，

paragraphs.en: which is part of the infrastructure question.
paragraphs.zh: 這也是基礎設施問題的一環。

paragraphs.en: European Council President Antonio Costa
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲理事會主席安東尼奧．科斯塔

paragraphs.en: also emphasised the importance of actually using AI.
paragraphs.zh: 也強調實際採用人工智慧的重要性。

paragraphs.en: In his remarks after the meeting,
paragraphs.zh: 他在會後談話中

paragraphs.en: he linked adoption across the economy
paragraphs.zh: 將整體經濟中的技術採用

paragraphs.en: with the possibility of higher productivity.
paragraphs.zh: 與提高生產力的可能性連結起來。

paragraphs.en: This points to a practical distinction:
paragraphs.zh: 這點帶出一項實際區分：

paragraphs.en: developing advanced models and helping organisations use them
paragraphs.zh: 開發先進模型與協助組織使用模型，

paragraphs.en: are related but different tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 是相關卻不同的工作。

paragraphs.en: Another guest, Nobel Prize laureate Geoffrey Hinton,
paragraphs.zh: 另一位來賓是諾貝爾獎得主傑佛瑞．辛頓，

paragraphs.en: joined the discussion of AI's social impact.
paragraphs.zh: 他參與了人工智慧社會影響的討論。

paragraphs.en: Topics included children's rights, democratic processes,
paragraphs.zh: 議題包括兒童權利、民主程序、

paragraphs.en: labour markets, market concentration, and cybersecurity.
paragraphs.zh: 勞動市場、市場集中與網路安全。

paragraphs.en: These subjects extend beyond
paragraphs.zh: 這些主題超出了

paragraphs.en: the performance of a particular software product.
paragraphs.zh: 單一特定軟體產品的效能。

paragraphs.en: They concern how powerful technology
paragraphs.zh: 它們關係到強大的科技

paragraphs.en: interacts with institutions and people's lives.
paragraphs.zh: 如何與制度及人們的生活互相影響。

paragraphs.en: Costa argued that clear oversight
paragraphs.zh: 科斯塔主張，明確的監督

paragraphs.en: is necessary for public confidence in AI.
paragraphs.zh: 是公眾對人工智慧建立信心的必要條件。

paragraphs.en: He presented trust as a condition
paragraphs.zh: 他將信任視為一項條件，

paragraphs.en: for a successful strategy,
paragraphs.zh: 有了它，策略才能成功，

paragraphs.en: rather than a separate issue to consider later.
paragraphs.zh: 而不是留待日後再考慮的獨立議題。

paragraphs.en: He also called for European participation
paragraphs.zh: 他也呼籲歐洲參與

paragraphs.en: in international discussions about responsible AI governance,
paragraphs.zh: 有關負責任人工智慧治理的國際討論，

paragraphs.en: including debates in the United Nations.
paragraphs.zh: 其中包括聯合國內的討論。

paragraphs.en: Ireland's announcement before the meeting
paragraphs.zh: 愛爾蘭在會議前發布的公告

paragraphs.en: had already outlined this balance.
paragraphs.zh: 就已勾勒出這種平衡。

paragraphs.en: Prime Minister Micheal Martin described opportunities for innovation,
paragraphs.zh: 總理米歇爾．馬丁描述了創新機會，

paragraphs.en: while also highlighting risks for societies and democracies.
paragraphs.zh: 同時也強調社會與民主制度面臨的風險。

paragraphs.en: He framed the meeting as a chance
paragraphs.zh: 他將會議定位為一次機會，

paragraphs.en: to consider further action
paragraphs.zh: 讓各方思考後續行動，

paragraphs.en: while building on existing regulations.
paragraphs.zh: 並以現有規範為基礎。

paragraphs.en: His comments brought industry and research perspectives
paragraphs.zh: 他的談話將產業與研究觀點

paragraphs.en: into the same political conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 帶入同一場政治討論。

paragraphs.en: The discussion will continue beyond Dublin.
paragraphs.zh: 討論將在都柏林會議後持續進行。

paragraphs.en: Costa said leaders would return to AI
paragraphs.zh: 科斯塔表示，領袖們將再次討論人工智慧，

paragraphs.en: at their February 5, 2027, meeting in Alden Biesen.
paragraphs.zh: 時間為2027年2月5日，地點在奧爾登比森。

paragraphs.en: He also identified AI's effects on society and jobs
paragraphs.zh: 他也將人工智慧對社會與工作的影響

paragraphs.en: as a central theme for the 2027 Social Summit.
paragraphs.zh: 列為2027年社會高峰會的核心主題。

paragraphs.en: Those announcements describe a future agenda,
paragraphs.zh: 這些宣布描述的是未來議程，

paragraphs.en: not completed solutions to the challenges raised.
paragraphs.zh: 不代表會中提出的挑戰已經獲得解決。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the accounts show
paragraphs.zh: 綜合來看，這些紀錄顯示，

paragraphs.en: why AI policy involves several connected choices.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧政策涉及多項彼此連結的選擇。

paragraphs.en: Investment and adoption address economic capacity,
paragraphs.zh: 投資與採用關係到經濟能力，

paragraphs.en: while oversight and cooperation address confidence and accountability.
paragraphs.zh: 監督與合作則關係到信心與問責。

paragraphs.en: For Europe's technology sector,
paragraphs.zh: 對歐洲科技業而言，

paragraphs.en: the Dublin meeting signals political attention
paragraphs.zh: 都柏林會議顯示，政治層面的關注

paragraphs.en: across this whole range of issues.
paragraphs.zh: 涵蓋了這整組議題。

paragraphs.en: The next test is how those discussions
paragraphs.zh: 接下來要看的，是這些討論

paragraphs.en: are translated into practical decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 如何化為實際決策。

access.meaning: 取得、使用的機會；文中指取得能源

accountability.meaning: 問責、負責；文中指對人工智慧的發展與使用負責

accounts.meaning: 紀錄、敘述；文中指官方報告與談話紀錄

adoption.meaning: 採用；文中指實際運用人工智慧

alden.meaning: Alden；Alden Biesen為比利時奧爾登比森的地名

an.meaning: 一個、一種；母音發音前的不定冠詞

are.meaning: 是；也可作被動語態的助動詞

artificial.meaning: 人工的；artificial intelligence指人工智慧

as.meaning: 作為、當作；as well as指也、以及

biesen.meaning: Biesen；Alden Biesen為比利時奧爾登比森的地名

both.meaning: 兩者都；both A and B指A與B兩者

brought.meaning: 使來到一起；brought together 指讓…齊聚

chains.meaning: 鏈、鏈條（複數）；supply chains指供應鏈

clean.meaning: 潔淨的；文中指潔淨能源

concentration.meaning: 集中；market concentration指市場集中於少數企業的情況

council.meaning: 理事會；文中European Council指由歐盟領袖組成的歐洲理事會

dedicated.meaning: 專門的、針對特定主題的

democracies.meaning: 民主制度、民主社會（複數）

for.meaning: 為了、對於；也表示某時段的

had.meaning: 與過去分詞連用，構成過去完成式

in.meaning: 在某時間、領域或範圍中

institutions.meaning: 制度、機構；文中指與科技互相影響的社會制度及機構

is.meaning: 是；也可作被動或進行式的助動詞

micheal.meaning: Micheal；米歇爾，愛爾蘭人名Micheál的無重音符號寫法

mistral.meaning: Mistral；人工智慧公司Mistral AI的名稱

nations.meaning: 國家；United Nations 指聯合國

nobel.meaning: 諾貝爾；Nobel Prize指諾貝爾獎

of.meaning: …的；表示所屬、性質、內容等關係

on.meaning: 關於、就某事；也表示日期

points.meaning: 指向、帶出；points to指顯示、指出

powerful.meaning: 強大的、有重大影響力的

president.meaning: 主席；文中指歐洲理事會主席

public.meaning: 公眾的、公共的；public investment指公部門投資

return.meaning: 重新回到；return to指重新討論

taken.meaning: 與together連用；taken together指綜合來看

test.meaning: 考驗；文中指後續須觀察的實際成果

that.meaning: 那個；也可引導內容子句或關係子句

the.meaning: 定冠詞，指特定或前文提過的事物

their.meaning: 他們的；文中指歐盟領袖的

them.meaning: 它們；文中指人工智慧模型

to.meaning: 到、向；也用於不定詞，接動詞原形

united.meaning: 聯合的；United Nations 指聯合國

quiz.question: What is the main message of the article?

choices.text: EU leaders discussed AI as both an economic opportunity and a matter of public trust.
choices.explanation: 正確。第一段將競爭力與公眾信任連結，後文分別說明投資、採用、監督與社會影響。

choices.text: The Dublin meeting completed every decision needed for European AI policy.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段說未來仍有討論議程，第八段則指出接下來要看討論如何轉化為決策。

choices.text: AI policy should be limited to improving individual software products.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第四段說討論超越單一產品效能，涉及制度、權利及人們的生活。

choices.text: Public trust was excluded from the economic discussion.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第一段將兩者連結，第五段更將信任視為策略成功的條件。

quiz.explanation: 文章主旨是雙重關注：一方面提升經濟競爭力，另一方面建立公眾信任並處理社會影響。第一與第八段呼應這個結構，因此第一個選項最完整。

evidence.quote: Their first dedicated strategic discussion on artificial intelligence connected two concerns: economic competitiveness and public trust.
Investment and adoption address economic capacity, while oversight and cooperation address confidence and accountability.

quiz.question: What can be inferred from the discussion of developing models and adopting AI?

choices.text: Developing a model automatically means every organisation will use it effectively.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段把模型開發與協助組織採用視為不同工作，不能自動視為同一結果。

choices.text: Organisations should wait until all model development has stopped before using AI.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章未提出這種等待條件，第三段強調的是採用的重要性。

choices.text: Technical development and practical use require attention as related but distinct tasks.
choices.explanation: 正確。第三段直接指出，開發先進模型與協助組織使用模型相關，但屬於不同工作。

choices.text: Productivity gains were described as impossible.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段說採用人工智慧與提升生產力的可能性有關，並未否定這種可能。

quiz.explanation: 第三段說明模型開發與實際採用之間的區別。模型存在並不足以代表組織已能有效使用，因此兩項相關工作都需要關注，而不能互相取代。

evidence.quote: This points to a practical distinction: developing advanced models and helping organisations use them are related but different tasks.

quiz.question: Which conclusion is best supported by the announced future meetings?

choices.text: All social risks from AI have already been removed.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段明確說未來議程不代表相關挑戰已經解決。

choices.text: AI remains an ongoing political issue, with further discussion of its social effects planned.
choices.explanation: 正確。第七段列出2027年2月會議及社會高峰會的相關議程，顯示討論將持續。

choices.text: EU leaders will stop considering employment issues.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段將人工智慧對工作與社會的影響列為2027年社會高峰會核心主題。

choices.text: The future agenda proves that every organisation has already adopted AI.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。議程只代表後續討論規劃，無法證明所有組織已採用人工智慧。

quiz.explanation: 未來會議安排能支持「政策討論仍在持續」這項結論，但不能用來證明風險已消失或政策已全面落實。第七段同時提供日程與這項限制。

evidence.quote: He also identified AI's effects on society and jobs as a central theme for the 2027 Social Summit. Those announcements describe a future agenda, not completed solutions to the challenges raised.
